problem_statement: The os mgmt memory-pool-statistics (mpstat) command returns a CBOR response that does not match the documented layout. The documented layout is a flat map keyed by pool name, each value being a map of "blksiz"/"nblks"/"nfree"/"min". In reality the response wraps every pool entry inside an extra "tasks" key, so a client decoding the documented layout cannot parse the entries (the first key it sees is "tasks" instead of the pool index). The response must contain the per-pool maps directly, without the extra "tasks" wrapper.
